summary: Ingles Markets filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 8, 2026, its board elected Kevin Hefner, 53, as a director to fill the vacancy created by Brenda S. Tudor's previously reported departure from the Class B-elected seat, appointing him to the Audit Committee and as chairman of the Compensation and Governance Committee. His term runs to the 2027 annual meeting. The board also adopted Amended and Restated Bylaws covering shareholder-meeting procedures, Rule 14a-19 compliance, an Executive Chairman role, conflict transactions and an exclusive forum provision.
